id, name, course_code, teacher_id, semester, school,
#{id}, #{name}, #{courseCode}, #{teacherId}, #{semester}, #{school},
mapper.update:
update Course
name = #{name},
course_code = #{courseCode},
teacher_id = #{teacherId},
semester = #{semester},
school = #{school},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.name AS teacherName, u.phone AS teacherPhone, u.email AS teacherEmail FROM Teach t JOIN Course c ON t.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN User u ON c.teacher_id = u.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
